Name: Bukki, Son of Abishua
Summary: Son of Abishua and priest in Aaron's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 6:5; 1 Chronicles 6:51: Son of Abishua and priest in Aaron's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Bukki stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
